card.tagline: Germany — moderately fast Bohemian dance in 24 time
card.profile:
The Špacírka is a moderately fast Bohemian dance in 24 time.  The dance starts out slowly with the dancer(s) walking; it is from this that the dance got its name: in Czech "špacírovat" (coming from the German word Spazieren) means "to walk around. "
The dance was used by some Czech composers, for example Antonín Dvořák in his Slavonic Dances, with the Špacírka as the fifth dance from opus 72.
card.insight: The Špacírka is a moderately fast Bohemian dance in 24 time.
